title: pmx workflow genome v1
description: Genome.workflow of CONTRACTS_V2 18.4 (amendment C1c): a bounded DAG of steps from a closed catalogue, in topological order, with edges (from, to) such that from < to, sorted; the canonical form, so two workflows that draw the same graph serialise to the same bytes. steps[0] is sense and steps[-1] is actions; exactly one of each; at least one belief or llm_belief; at most one sizing and one propose_rule; at most 12 steps, depth 8, width 4; every step reachable from step 0 and every step but propose_rule reaching the last. The schema states the per-item shape and the bounds it can; Workflow.__post_init__ refuses the rest with InvalidConfigError. null in a genome means the linear composition of 10.1.
